behaviours.name: search
behaviours.summary: Go to the target's last known position, then sweep

behaviours.name: approach
behaviours.summary: Close to preferred range using the manoeuvre

behaviours.name: melee_attack
behaviours.summary: Close and use the basic melee attack

behaviours.name: ranged_attack
behaviours.summary: Hold range and sight, then use the basic ranged attack

behaviours.name: ability_1
behaviours.summary: Get in range and cast the species ability

behaviours.name: ability_2
behaviours.summary: Get in range and cast the second ability

behaviours.name: ability_3
behaviours.summary: The species' special ability, or a support's fallback attack when no escort is near

behaviours.name: flee
behaviours.summary: Move away along the route field

behaviours.name: take_cover
behaviours.summary: Move to nearby cover that blocks sight from the target

behaviours.name: hide
behaviours.missing: Legal only while the host has darkness on (MobSim.set_darkness).
behaviours.summary: Break sight and stay in darkness

behaviours.name: defend_ally
behaviours.summary: Stay between the ally and its nearest threat

behaviours.name: dodge
behaviours.summary: Sidestep the nearest threat, ignoring hits briefly. Agile species only

behaviours.name: channel
behaviours.summary: Stand still and refill mana, taking extra damage. Mana species only

behaviours.name: roam
behaviours.summary: Travel a few metres toward the scent of the nearest player. Weaker smell and greater distance make the heading less accurate
